'''Miow Joon''', nicknamed the '''Noodle Peddler''', was an [[Miow Joon's species|alien]] champion [[velospeeder]] rider who worked peddling the [[noodle]]-drying rack at the [[Lomi Usqi Noodle Shop]] on the [[Planet|world]] [[Ueda]] during his training seasons. He was overqualified for the role but offered his services in exchange for free [[Foodstuff|food]] and a space to work out. In [[132 BBY]], Joon was peddling the rack in the shop when the [[Sith assassin|assassin]] [[Mae-ho Aniseya]] [[Mae's quest|confronted]] the [[Jedi Master]] [[Indara]]. Joon continued peddling as the pair fought, with Aniseya eventually [[Indara's murder|killing]] the [[Jedi]].

==Biography==
[[File:MiowJoonPeddling-AcolyteVD.png|thumb|right|300px|alt=Arms braced on a bar behind him, Miow Joon uses his feet like hands to turn two pedals connected to a wheel beside hanging noodles in the Lomi Usqi Noodle Shop.|Miow Joon worked in the Lomi Usqi Noodle Shop on Ueda during his training seasons.]]
Miow Joon was an [[Miow Joon's species|alien]] [[velospeeder]] rider who lived during the [[High Republic Era]] and,<ref name="AcolyteVG" /> by [[132 BBY]],<ref name="Date">{{TheAcolyteDate}}</ref> had become a champion in the profession. During his training seasons, he traveled to the [[Planet|world]] [[Ueda]], where, despite being overqualified for the job, he worked to keep the circular [[noodle]]-drying rack spinning at the [[Lomi Usqi Noodle Shop]] in [[Point Ueda]]. The spinning spaced out the edible strands of noodle in order to prevent them from clumping together while they dried. In exchange for the work, Joon received a space to work out and free [[Foodstuff|food]] that was packed with [[carbohydrate]]s. Patrons of the noodle shop prefered Joon to the noisy [[Engine|motor]] that operated the drying rack in his absense, and the role earned him the nickname "the Noodle Peddler."<ref name="AcolyteVG" />

In 132 [['ABY-BBY' dating system|BBY]],<ref name="Date" /> Joon was in the noodle shop peddling on a perch beside the noodle-drying rack to keep it turning when the [[Sith assassin|assassin]] [[Mae-ho Aniseya]] entered the shop in [[Mae's quest|search]] of [[Jedi Master]] [[Indara]]. Aniseya confronted the [[Jedi]] and started a bar fight, causing many other patrons to flee. Joon, however, remained on his perch and continued peddling as the fight continued, with the drying rack still turning even as Aniseya threw a [[Mae's knives|throwing knife]] at<ref name="Lost Found">{{Acolyte|Lost / Found}}</ref> the shop's owner, [[Cabuck]],<ref name="AcolyteVG" /> in order to distract Indara. When the Jedi saved Cabuck [[Force power|with]] [[the Force]], the [[assassin]] [[Indara's murder|killed]] her before leaving the establishment.<ref name="Lost Found" />

==Personality and traits==
Miow Joon was a burly and muscular individual with athletic biceps that allowed him to grip onto the perch at the Lomi Usqi Noodle Shop. He was willing to do a job he was overqualified for in exchange for free food and a workout space. The alien had primarily [[Color|gray]] skin with purple areas around his fingers, [[nose]], [[ear]]s, and blue [[eye]]s.<ref name="AcolyteVG" />

==Equipment==
While at the noodle shop, Joon wore a brown canvas [[Clothing|working apron]].<ref name="AcolyteVG" />

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|We came to the conclusion that he's a galactic champion cycle rider in training, so obviously the noodle bar is the perfect place fro him to work as long as he gets his carbohydrates. We put a modesty cloth on him by the end. Training in the nude was not acceptable.|Neal Scanlan|<ref name="ArtOf">''[[The Art of Star Wars: The Acolyte]]''</ref>}}
Miow Joon first appeared in "[[Lost / Found]],"<ref name="Lost Found" /> the first episode of the television series ''[[Star Wars: The Acolyte]]'', which aired [[June 4]], [[2024]] on [[Disney+]].<ref name="Announcement">{{SW|url=news/the-acolyte-teaser-poster|text=''The Acolyte'' Teaser Poster, Premiere Date Revealed}}</ref> Creature concept designer [[Ivan Manzella]] created concept art and a render of Miow Joon, both titled "Noodle Grinder." According to creature and droid FX creative supervisor [[Neal Scanlan]], the idea of Joon being a champion cycler was created during the production process, although they added a modesty cloth to the creature to avoid it being nude.<ref name="ArtOf" /> The scenes in the shop were filmed at [[Shinfield Studios]],<ref name="Fantha Part I">{{WebCite|url=https://www.fanthatracks.com/news/the-acolyte-a-journey-to-the-filming-locations-part-1-madeira|text=The Acolyte: A journey to the filming locations Part 1: Madeira|archivedate=20241204220147}}</ref> [[Wikipedia:England|England]].<ref name="Julian Foddy">{{Lucasfilm|url=news/julian-foddy-acolyte|text=''The Acolyte'' Visual Effects Supervisor Julian Foddy}}</ref> The character was first identified in the [[2025]] reference book ''[[Star Wars: The Acolyte: The Visual Guide]]'', which was written by [[Pablo Hidalgo]].<ref name="AcolyteVG" />
